description: after rebinding switch-applications, <Super>Tab is no longer bound

fired.sh: for schema in org.gnome.desktop.wm.keybindings org.gnome.shell.keybindings org.gnome.mutter.keybindings org.gnome.mutter.wayland.keybindings org.gnome.settings-daemon.plugins.media-keys; do gsettings list-recursively $schema; done | grep -F "'<Super>Tab'"
